source_reference.warning: Reference-map geometry is a review prompt only. Do not copy it into after_roof_labels.

label_definition.real_visible_change: A permanent change is visibly supported by the fixed before/after imagery.
label_definition.mapping_only_or_not_visible: The reference-map difference is not a visible permanent change in the fixed imagery pair.
label_definition.after_roof_labels: Human-drawn after-date roof outlines. They must remain empty until manually digitised from the after image.

required_properties.object_id: unique stable string, for example docklands-001-roof-01
required_properties.reference_candidate_ids: list of reviewed official-reference candidate IDs, possibly empty
